minor.issue:
P1-FEAT-9 (line-continuation): router RC4.5 backtick hook in /app/backend/routers/ops.py L~1310 gates on regex `[A-Za-z0-9_] which excludes the `?
 line-continuation pattern. The ps_backtick_normalizer module DOES support _RX_LINE_CONT (r'`[ 	]*?
[ 	]*') but the router never invokes it for pure line-continuation inputs. Input `powershell `
  -NoProfile `
  -Command 'x'` is handed to RC4.3 which leaves the backtick+newline untouched. Fix: change the guard to `if '`' in src and (_re.search(r'`[A-Za-z0-9_]', src) or _re.search(r'`[ 	]*?
', src)):`

P1-FEAT-9 (escape preservation): for input `"line1`n line2"` the whole output_raw response body becomes ONLY the module's status line '(powershell-backtick-normalize · no backtick obfuscation found)' — original input / reconstructed form is lost. The router correctly skips replacement when the module reports no-change, but some upstream code path is setting output_raw to that status string. Test asserts `n survives — it does functionally (module never touched it), but output_raw doesn't expose it. Investigate whether the standalone `powershell-backtick-normalize` operation is being invoked as the sole pipeline step and its no-op message is being echoed as final output_raw.

rca_of_the_issue:
P1-FEAT-9 line-continuation failure — router hook boolean gate `_re.search(r'`[A-Za-z0-9_]', src)` requires a backtick to be followed by an alnum/underscore. Payload `powershell `<LF>  -NoProfile ...` places `<space><LF> after the backtick, so the gate returns None and the RC4.5 backtick module is never called. Then RC4.3 runs and reconstructs the command verbatim including the literal backtick+newline. Reproduction: POST /api/decode/smart {'input': "powershell `
  -NoProfile `
  -Command 'x'"}. Fix: extend guard to also accept `+?
. Mitigation: 1-line regex OR-expansion.
